fixes.explanation: A golden lampstand? Friend, that would've been a classy way to go wrong. But the psalm says, "At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image." A calf is what they made. I once had a drawer full of useful things and not one of them ever got worshiped, so I'm not sure how a calf got the job.

A new law? Friend, I get it, sometimes you hear "distress" and your brain reaches for the instruction manual. But the psalm says, "Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress." Not a rulebook, not a lecture. He heard them and He noticed. I think that's the best part of the whole verse.
